verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Circle Mint (converting USD↔existing USDC) and CPN (a self-managed model where the founder—not Circle—handles custody, payouts, and compliance for their own stablecoin lifecycle), but nothing documents a Circle-hosted white-label issuance product covering minting, redemption, and reserve management for a founder's own branded coin, nor any honest disclosure of eligibility gating for such a product.
